classification.difficultyReason: Directly translate six explicit inequalities into open/filled endpoints and left/right rays. Fractional endpoints require placement on a suitable scale but no solving or unfamiliar strategy.

content.prompt: Graph each set on the number line.

answer.short: Open dot at $2$; ray to the right.
answer.worked: Since $2$ is excluded, draw an open dot at $2$. Draw a ray to the right to show all numbers greater than $2$.

spec.description: Open endpoint at 2 and a rightward interval ray. Complete TikZ is used because the number-line template does not explicitly support interval rays.

answer.short: Open dot at $3$; ray to the left.
answer.worked: Since $3$ is excluded, draw an open dot at $3$. Draw a ray to the left to show all numbers less than $3$.

spec.description: Open endpoint at 3 and a leftward interval ray; interval rays require complete TikZ.

answer.short: Open dot at $-1\frac{1}{2}$; ray to the left.
answer.worked: Mark $-1\frac{1}{2}$ halfway between $-2$ and $-1$. Draw an open dot because the endpoint is excluded, then draw a ray to the left.

spec.description: Half-unit scale with an open endpoint at negative one and a half and a leftward interval ray; interval rays require complete TikZ.

answer.short: Filled dot at $4$; ray to the right.
answer.worked: Since $4$ is included, draw a filled dot at $4$. Draw a ray to the right to show all numbers greater than or equal to $4$.

spec.description: Filled endpoint at 4 and a rightward interval ray; interval rays require complete TikZ.

answer.short: Filled dot at $\frac{1}{3}$; ray to the right.
answer.worked: Divide the interval from $0$ to $1$ into three equal parts. Draw a filled dot at $\frac{1}{3}$ because it is included, then draw a ray to the right.

spec.description: Third-unit scale with a filled endpoint at one third and a rightward interval ray; interval rays require complete TikZ.

answer.short: Filled dot at $2\frac{1}{4}$; ray to the left.
answer.worked: Mark $2\frac{1}{4}$ one quarter of a unit to the right of $2$. Draw a filled dot because the endpoint is included, then draw a ray to the left.

spec.description: Half-unit ticks plus the marked quarter-unit endpoint, with labels 0, 1, 2 and two and a quarter. Filled endpoint and leftward interval ray require complete TikZ.
